Convert Pendle to earn
Convert PENDLE into mPENDLE and subsequently stake mPENDLE to get revenue share from Penpie and earn PNP incentives. Your rewards will be shown on the Claim page.

Buy $PENDLE.

Note: Once PENDLE is converted into mPENDLE, the process cannot be reversed. You have the option to stake and unstake your mPENDLE tokens, but converting them back to PENDLE directly is not possible. However, you can swap mPENDLE -> PENDLE on PancakeSwap, with rates subject to market conditions. Additionally, the smart Pendle Converter is now available on Arbitrum. If you bridge your PENDLE to Arbitrum and perform the conversion there, you have the potential to receive more mPENDLE as a bonus.
